commits.author: Paul Wannenmacher
commits.message:
ci: add workflow_dispatch trigger to release workflow (#1003)

* ci: add workflow_dispatch trigger to release workflow

Allows re-running the release pipeline manually (dispatched from a tag ref) when a tag push did not trigger it, e.g. tags created with GITHUB_TOKEN.

* fix(docker): drop COPY of empty Spring Boot 4 layers

Spring Boot 4's 'jarmode=tools extract --layers' no longer emits content into the spring-boot-loader and snapshot-dependencies layers. The empty directories are silently dropped by upload-artifact, so the artifact-based docker builds (release, experimental) failed on 'COPY /target/extracted/spring-boot-loader/': not found.

commits.message:
fix: keep framework status codes in ProblemDetail error handling (#990)

* fix: keep framework status codes in ProblemDetail error handling

The Exception catch-all in GlobalExceptionHandler turned AccessDeniedException
and the Spring MVC exceptions into 500. It now extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler
and maps AccessDeniedException to 403/401. ResponseStatusException reasons and
missing-cookie messages no longer bypass include-message.

* chore: remove dead server.error key from integration test config

Spring Boot 4 moved ErrorProperties to WebProperties; spring.web.error is already
configured in the same file.

* test: use @InjectMocks for GlobalExceptionHandler in tests

* test: update assertions in ProblemDetailFactoryTest for type and instance

* refactor: move the exception catch-all into a fallback advice

@ExceptionHandler(Exception.class) matches every exception, and Spring only walks
getCause() when the thrown type has no mapping. In GlobalExceptionHandler it therefore
suppressed cause resolution, which two manual findCause calls partly compensated. The
catch-all now sits in FallbackExceptionHandler at LOWEST_PRECEDENCE, so a wrapped
exception reaches its specific handler again.

* fix: address the review findings on the ProblemDetail error handling

- an exception carrying only a status reports the code matching it, so a 401 is
  AUTHENTICATION_FAILED instead of INVALID_INPUT; mapping shared via ErrorCode.forStatus
- @ResponseStatus on an exception class is honoured again instead of becoming 500
- ResponseStatusException without a reason no longer leaks the "404 NOT_FOUND" prefix
- fieldErrors follow include-binding-errors instead of include-message
- errors from the security filter chain are problem+json (ProblemDetailWriter)
- InternalAuthenticationServiceException yields 500 and is logged, not a silent 401
- handleExceptionInternal delegates to createResponseEntity, honours a committed
  response and resolves detail through MessageSource
- createProblemDetail is the single creation point behind every path
- 4xx logged at DEBUG, access denials at INFO

* refactor: improve field error handling in ParameterValidationResult
